package testdata

templ Branches(n int, items []string, x bool) {
	if n == 0 {
		<p>zero</p>
	} else if n == 1 {
		<div>else-if</div>
	} else {
		<div>else</div>
	}
	for _, it := range items {
		<div>{ it }</div>
	}
	switch n {
		case 2:
			<div>case</div>
	}
	@layout.Stack() {
		<div>call child</div>
	}
	<p
		if x {
			title="a"
		} else {
			style="b"
		}
	>cond</p>
}
